reason: The key premises are directly and accurately supported by the cited evidence: E2 demonstrates the exact hybrid-rolling process, the resulting dual heterogeneous microstructure, and the achieved strength-ductility combination; E1 shows that a related heterogeneous lamella structure in the same alloy activates microcrack-arresting mechanisms, supporting the proposed ductilizing mechanism.
premises: Cryo-rolling followed by warm-rolling at 600 °C produces a dual heterogeneous microstructure in AlCoCrFeNi2.1
This dual heterogeneous microstructure consists of retained lamellar and transformed nanocrystalline regions
The dual heterogeneous microstructure yields a combination of high strength (~2000 MPa) and ductility (~8%)
A dual-phase heterogeneous lamella structure in AlCoCrFeNi2.1 can activate microcrack-arresting mechanisms to extend ductility
